notes.title: Sword Art Online Fractured Daydream follows launch success with a new character
notes.content:
The recent launch of Sword Art Online Fractured Daydream proved that the long-standing anime franchise continues to hold sway. The new SAO RPG arrived just two weeks ago, pulling in thousands of players and a positive reception on Steam. Now, the latest release from Elden Ring and Tekken publisher Bandai Namco follows up on its initial success with a first DLC, which introduces Strea as a new playable character in a special story scenario alongside additional weapons and costumes.

notes.title: Co-op RPG Sword Art Online Fractured Daydream is blowing up on Steam
notes.content:
Sword Art Online is, seemingly, eternal. For more than two decades now, what originally began as a series of novels has spawned a plethora of adaptations and spin-offs ranging from various anime instalments and films to nearly two dozen different videogames. Even with all of this, audiences still seem very interested in more Sword Art. Its latest game, Sword Art Online Fractured Daydream, is a good example of this, as it's currently attracting huge player numbers on Steam since it launched yesterday.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Elden Ring publisher dates new RPG based on beloved anime series

notes.title: Team up for a new adventure in SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream
notes.content:
[h2]21 characters of heroes and villains from across Sword Art Online’s history collide in SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream, [b]available now[/b]![/h2]

[previewyoutube=ZUcHTy9mHxM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]In the vast virtual world of Alfheim Online, a new system called Galaxia is installed, and a malfunction causes all worlds and timelines to merge, creating a chaotic landscape for Kirito and his friends. Lost in this unfamiliar territory, they must form unlikely alliances and face new challenges to survive the dangers of this unsettled world.

SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream presents an [b]original story[/b] featuring fan-favorite characters like Asuna, Kirito, and Leafa, and offers [b]a thrilling Co-Op experience[/b] with cross-platform play. Players can engage in intense boss battles and cooperative quests in this action-packed game.

In single player offline mode, players can relive the story by [b]facing enemies and embark on their individual journey[/b] to fix the timeline caused by Galaxia’s outburst. While in online mode, players can team up, creating parties of[b] up to 20 players to play Co-Op Quest, Boss Raid and Free Roam.[/b]

[h2][b]SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream[/b] offers three editions detailed below:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Standard Edition[/b]
[*] [b]Deluxe Digital Edition[/b] including Character Pass Vol.1 which offers access to DLC 1 & 2 at their respective release date along with an exclusive stamp set, and Prism Heart Costume Set  
[*] [b]Digital Premium Edition[/b] including Character Pass Vol.1 which offers access to DLC 1 & 2 at their respective release date along with an exclusive stamp set, Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, a mini-game, Prism Heart Costume Set and Wild Joker Dress
[/list][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858630/SWORD_ART_ONLINE_Fractured_Daydream/

notes.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream launches in 1 day for STEAM!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Eiji[/b][/h2]
[h3]Role: Rogue[/h3]

A swordsman who utilizes acrobatic movements to gain mobility and become stronger.
He can easily adjust the distance towards enemies using special dash, and excels at fighting with a hit & retreat approach that he uses to overwhelm his enemies.

[h2][b]Yuna[/b][/h2]
[h3]Role: Support[/h3]

A support character who can continually buff allies.
These buffs depend on the state of her "Voltage Gauge", so it is crucial for her to keep singing as she fills this gauge.

[previewyoutube=f_y5yv7iIQU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]LLENN[/b][/h2]
[h3]Role: Rogue[/h3]

A highly mobile shooter who excels in close- and medium-range combat.
Approaching the enemy with tremendous speed, she strikes with an overwhelming number of attacks, using everything from submachine guns and even a knife.

[h2][b]Fukaziroh[/b][/h2]
[h3]Role: Ranger[/h3]

A grenadier who adapts to any battle fields, together with her grenade launchers, 
Rightony and Leftania, she will blast away enemies. She can also support allies by creating healing fields.

[previewyoutube=l8eqnh4awEE;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858630/SWORD_ART_ONLINE_Fractured_Daydream/

notes.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream launches in 2 days for STEAM!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Eugeo[/b][/h2]
[h3]Role: Mage[/h3]

A sub-attacker that can use the status effect Freeze to immobilize enemies within a wide area.
He can show incredible space control abilities, especially through his Unique Skill  and his Ultimate, inflicting the Freeze status effect on all the surrounding enemies.

[previewyoutube=KXGwIEuqt60;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Alice[/b][/h2]
[h3]Role: Tank[/h3]

She normally fights using simple fencing techniques, but when she uses her Unique Skill Enhance Armament
she changes her fighting style and transforms into an attacking fortress that decimates enemies with powerful area attacks.

[previewyoutube=7LfBHLbHnKs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Administrator[/b][/h2]
[h3]Role: Mage[/h3]

She is an all-rounder that excels at fighting both with a sword and with magic.
She retains her power as a ruler, being able to dominate any battle thanks to her ability to combine many close-range attacks with powerful long-range magic attacks.
She can also fight with a three-dimensional approach by flying.

[h3]SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream unveils[b][url=https://bnent.eu/SAOFD_SystemTrailer] an extensive look at its gameplay[/url][/b] and the two game modes that await in this large-scale multiplayer game. Get ready to dive into colliding virtual worlds!

In this system trailer, learn how to unleash combos, enhance your weapons and navigate the quests to emerge victorious in epic battles. Watch beloved SWORD ART ONLINE characters such as Kirito, Sinon, Agil, Yuuki and many more in action, each demonstrating their skills and powers according to their role in the party. Kirito, his friends and enemies find themselves displaced and forced to work together to fix the timeline.

[*][b]In the online mode Co-Op Quests[/b], create a party of up to 20 players and challenge vicious enemies from the SWORD ART ONLINE Series.

notes.title: "SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream" Game Modes
notes.content:
[h3]SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream is an exciting new beginning as we enter the 10th anniversary of the SWORD ART ONLINE game series![/h3]

Time and space, displaced
Galaxia, a new system allowing players to relive the past, has been added to ALfheim Online; however, Galaxia spins out of control causing players from all over time and space to be displaced! To set the timeline back on track, Kirito must work with fallen friends...and foes.

Choose your character and join the fight
Each with their own specific role on the battlefield, SAO characters from various arcs are gathered to fight. Team up with a total of 20 players from around the world in 1 of 5 parties comprised of 4 players each for multiplayer co-op action!

Defeat high difficulty bosses in Raids
True to the SWORD ART ONLINE series, join a raid party and prepare for a fight with high difficulty bosses together! How you prepare for the fight is the key to victory!

In addition to the elements of the offline mode where you can enjoy the story experience, this title also has an extensive online mode! Experience the "large-scale co-op action" that is unique to this title!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858630/SWORD_ART_ONLINE_Fractured_Daydream/

notes.title: A new adventure is coming this year
notes.content:
[h3]The first large-scale multiplayer-focused adventure based on the popular Sword Art Online series, "SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream" is coming this year.[/h3]

Experience the first "online co-op action" in the console game series with up to 20 players. ━━━━ 



A revolutionary new feature called "Galaxia" has been implemented into ALfheim Online. Originally intended to realistically recreate the past, Galaxia has malfunctioned and now the lines between the past and present are blurred making the future uncertain.

However, this technology suddenly shows signs of going out of control, causing all players and the world to blend together.
To deal with this anomaly, Kirito joins forces with friends and foes from his past.

Go beyond your memories - let's go, ""Switch""!

Characters from the SAO series with various roles in the game transcend memories.
Players can team up with up to 20 other players from around the world in this online co-op action game to face off against the powerful enemies that await them!

[previewyoutube=Wiu10JcnBUE;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858630/SWORD_ART_ONLINE_Fractured_Daydream/
